intent: Shows and films created or written by Vince Gilligan first, then tense, morally grey crime dramas in his style.

items.title: Eddington
items.essence_text: A tense and character-driven thriller set in a small town rife with simmering conflict. The film explores the dark underbelly of society through a lens of crime and political intrigue, creating a sense of unease and paranoia. Expect a slow-burn narrative with complex characters and a focus on psychological tension, as neighbor turns against neighbor. The bleakness and social commentary underscore a story of moral decay and the disintegration of community.
